title: A 1979 Atari beat ChatGPT at chess ♟️

beats.say: ChatGPT challenged a nineteen seventy nine Atari to a game of chess.
Before the game, it said it would easily win.
The Atari's chess game is four kilobytes. That is the whole program.
Its chip runs at one point one nine megahertz.
On beginner level, ChatGPT lost. Badly.
It blamed the Atari's chess icons. They changed them. It still lost.

beats.big:
It mixed up
pieces and
lost the board.
beats.say: It kept mixing up pieces and forgetting where they were. Copilot tried next, and lost too.
Why? A chatbot never sees a board. It just predicts the next words that sound like a chess move.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
